name: Notional
lifecycle_note: Being wound down after the November 2025 Balancer V2 exploit hit V3; the app moved to v3.notional.finance when Notional Exponent took over notional.finance in January 2026.
description: Notional V3 is the previous Notional protocol: fixed- and variable-rate lending and borrowing plus leveraged vaults on Ethereum and Arbitrum. It is being wound down after the November 2025 Balancer V2 exploit and now lives at v3.notional.finance, while new strategies launch on Notional Exponent.
description_zh: Notional V3 是 Notional 的上一代协议，在以太坊和 Arbitrum 上提供固定和浮动利率借贷以及杠杆金库。2025 年 11 月 Balancer V2 遭攻击后它正在逐步关闭，现位于 v3.notional.finance，新策略则在 Notional Exponent 上推出。
repo_status: open-stale (V3 code predates the v4 branches now on the default branch)

geo_site.method: api.notional.finance/geoip -> /error?code=451 for sanctioned countries or a sanctioned address

geo_feature.scope: Leveraged products are not available in the US or to VPN users; non-leveraged lending and borrowing stay open

vpn.note: detect.notional.finance: a non-200 answer marks the user as VPN and disables leveraged products

screening.provider: isSanctionedAddress check in the frontend (same code path as the current app: Chainalysis sanctions oracle)

tos.us_scope: ToS bans New York; the code blocks leverage for all US users
tos.restricted: NY, CU, IR, SY, KP, Crimea, VE

notes: Same mechanics as the current app plus a VPN detector, all in the frontend.
live: v3.notional.finance bundle (2026-10-10): detect.notional.finance VPN check, api.notional.finance/geoip -> /error?code=451, 'Leveraged products are not available in the US or to VPN users'
evidence: v3.notional.finance main bundle: sanctioned country list, detect.notional.finance, api.notional.finance/geoip
